```lisp
; Define the domain and problem
(define (domain kitchen-tasks)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types robot object)
  (:predicates
    (at ?robot - robot ?object - object)
    (holding ?robot - robot ?object - object)
    (sliced ?object - object)
    (cleaned ?object - object)
    (inaction ?robot - robot)
  )
  (:durative-action GoToObject
    :parameters (?robot - robot ?object - object)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (over all (inaction ?robot)))
    :effect (and (at end (at ?robot ?object))
                 (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
                 (at end (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  (:durative-action PickupObject
    :parameters (?robot - robot ?object - object)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (over all (at ?robot ?object))
                    (over all (inaction ?robot)))
    :effect (and (at end (holding ?robot ?object))
                 (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
                 (at end (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  (:durative-action SliceObject
    :parameters (?robot - robot ?potato - object ?knife - object)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (over all (holding ?robot ?knife))
                    (over all (holding ?robot ?potato))
                    (over all (inaction ?robot)))
    :effect (and (at end (sliced ?potato))
                 (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
                 (at end (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  (:durative-action CleanObject
    :parameters (?robot - robot ?plate - object)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (over all (holding ?robot ?plate))
                    (over all (inaction ?robot)))
    :effect (and (at end (cleaned ?plate))
                 (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
                 (at end (inaction ?robot)))
  )
  (:durative-action PutObject
    :parameters (?robot - robot ?slicedPotato - object ?plate - object)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (over all (holding ?robot ?slicedPotato))
                    (over all (at ?robot ?plate))
                    (over all (inaction ?robot)))
    :effect (and (at end (at ?slicedPotato ?plate))
                 (at end (not (holding ?robot ?slicedPotato)))
                 (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
                 (at end (inaction ?robot)))
  )
)

(define (problem kitchen-problem)
  (:domain kitchen-tasks)
  (:objects
    robot1 robot2 - robot
    potato knife plate sink - object
  )
  (:init
    (inaction robot1)
    (inaction robot2)
    (at robot1 knife)
    (at robot2 plate)
  )
  (:goal
    (and
      (sliced potato)
      (cleaned plate)
      (at potato plate)
    )
  )
  (:plan
    ; Parallel execution of SubTask 1 and SubTask 2
    (parallel
      (sequence
        (GoToObject robot1 knife)
        (PickupObject robot1 knife)
        (GoToObject robot1 potato)
        (PickupObject robot1 potato)
        (SliceObject robot1 potato knife)
      )
      (sequence
        (GoToObject robot2 plate)
        (PickupObject robot2 plate)
        (GoToObject robot2 sink)
        (CleanObject robot2 plate)
      )
    )
    ; SubTask 3: Put the Sliced Potato on the Plate
    (sequence
      (GoToObject robot1 potato)
      (PickupObject robot1 potato)
      (GoToObject robot1 plate)
      (PutObject robot1 potato plate)
    )
  )
)
```

- **Parallel Execution:** SubTask 1 (slicing the potato) and SubTask 2 (cleaning the plate) are executed in parallel by different robots.
- **Sequential Execution:** SubTask 3 (putting the sliced potato on the plate) is executed after both SubTask 1 and SubTask 2 are completed.
- **Corrected Variables:** All location variables are corrected to reference the objects directly, as the objects themselves imply their locations.
- **Timed Durative Actions:** Each action is defined with a duration and conditions to ensure proper execution flow.
